catalysts.headline: Elmet Group reports Q3 2026 results (quarter ended Oct 2, 2026): revenue $79.6M (+55.6-56% YoY) vs $51.1M prior year; net income $8.3M vs $1.6M prior year; open order backlog ~$347.4M (+298% YoY, +164% QoQ); effective tax rate 39.9%; Engineered Microwave Products segment posted operating loss of ~$570K; G&A up 72% to $9.6M; earnings call held 8:00am ET
Q3 2026 earnings call held today (8:00am ET) for fiscal quarter ended 2026-10-02; figures not yet indexed by search at research time
Elmet Group reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $0.35 (vs. $0.14 est., a 159% beat) and revenue of $80M (vs. $65M est.), citing a $347M backlog
catalysts.impact: Large earnings beat for a recently-IPO'd company

catalysts.headline: The Elmet Group scheduled its Q3 2026 (quarter ended Oct 2, 2026) earnings conference call and webcast for November 10, 2026 at 8:00 AM ET; a press release with results is to precede the call.
catalysts.note: Aggregator attributes the underlying notice to a GlobeNewswire release; GlobeNewswire itself was unreachable this session to confirm directly.

catalysts.headline: RESOLVES PRIOR TIMING CONFLICT: the Masan High-Tech Materials (MSR) 4.99% stake sale to The Elmet Group CLOSED on this date, per a Dechert LLP announcement (Dechert advised Masan Group on the sale for $124.75M, implying a $2.5B MSR equity valuation). The actual close (Oct 1) falls within the 'H1 October 2026' window one source estimated; the other source's 'Q3 2026' reference appears to have simply been wrong or used a non-calendar quarter convention. No company 8-K confirming the Oct 1 closing itself (only the Sept 23, 2026 signing 8-K) was located — this is a one-source (legal-advisor) confirmation, not a primary filing.
catalysts.source: Dechert LLP, 'Dechert advises Masan Group on US$125 million sale of stake in Masan High-Tech Materials to The Elmet Group', published 2026-10-22

catalysts.headline: Elmet acquired a 4.99% equity stake in MSR (UPCoM: MSR) for $124.75M

catalysts.headline: Agreed to acquire a 4.99% equity stake in Masan High-Tech Materials (Vietnam-based tungsten producer) from a Masan Group subsidiary for $124.75 million, implying a $2.5B equity valuation for Masan High-Tech Materials; paired with an 8+ year tungsten supply agreement targeting the U.S. market; Masan Group retains ~87.46% control
catalysts.note: Sources differ on expected closing timing: one (Mining Technology) cites first half of October 2026, another (RTTNews) cites Q3 2026; not reconciled

catalysts.headline: Secured a long-term tungsten offtake agreement to take more than 1,000 metric tonnes per year of tungsten concentrate (WO3 equivalent) from the Hemerdon mine (Devon, England), operated by Tungsten West
Pentagon agreed to invest $450M in Elmet Group to expand domestic tungsten production (date approximate — reported as a 'Monday' in mid-September 2026)
catalysts.impact: Stock jumped above a technical buy point per the secondary source
catalysts.source: Investor's Business Daily, via WebSearch summary (specific article URL not captured)

catalysts.headline: Department of War announced a $450 million redeemable preferred equity investment in Elmet (with warrants for up to 19.9% of common stock); subsidiary Elmet Technologies received a Defense Logistics Agency award with a $2 billion ceiling and a $150 million guaranteed funded commitment for tungsten ores/concentrates and sodium tungstate for the National Defense Stockpile
catalysts.impact: Shares surged ~30% (reports of up to +48% premarket) on the session

catalysts.headline: Department of War announced a $450 million redeemable preferred equity investment in Elmet (via its Industrial Base Analysis and Sustainment program / Economic Defense Unit; Elmet to draw $200M initially, DoW to receive preferred equity + warrants for up to 19.9% of common stock plus one independent board seat and one non-voting observer); separately, subsidiary Elmet Technologies received a Defense Logistics Agency IDIQ-type award with a $2 billion ceiling and a guaranteed funded commitment of $150 million, covering tungsten ores/concentrates and sodium tungstate for the National Defense Stockpile. Elmet plans ~$165M into US facilities and ~$150M into the Springer Tungsten Complex (Nevada).
catalysts.note: One secondary source (ManufacturingDive) dates the DLA award to 2026-09-11 rather than 2026-09-14, and frames the DoW investment as a Class A preferred stock purchase rather than the preferred-equity-plus-warrants structure described in the official war.gov release; Quartr's summary calls the DLA deal a 'framework agreement' rather than a straight award -- see conflicts.

catalysts.headline: Department of War makes $450M committed investment in The Elmet Group; separate DLA award worth up to $2B to rebuild National Defense Stockpile tungsten supply
catalysts.impact: Shares surged ~30% (some reports up to +48% premarket) on the session

catalysts.headline: Agreed to acquire ams OSRAM's tungsten and molybdenum manufacturing operations in Schwabmünchen, Germany, via newly formed subsidiary Elmet Technologies GmbH; establishes Elmet's first EU refractory-metals manufacturing footprint; financial terms not disclosed; closing expected Q1 2027
catalysts.note: A deal-tracking database lists the underlying Asset Purchase Agreement as signed 2026-09-03, with trade-press coverage dated 2026-09-09
